_doc: CONFIRMED non-contrast trials evicted at SCREENING (armcontrast into screening): a screened-in record whose randomised contrast is NOT the intervention-vs-comparator of interest is excluded at ELIGIBILITY, not admitted then disclosed after pooling. Each entry is AUDIT-CONFIRMED from the trial's own design (not the machine registry granularity, which is unreliable), with the basis. This is the safe direction: evict only confirmed non-contrasts, never merely-unverified ones (a prior machine rule flagged 14 valid trials). Reason code X-CONTRAST / CONTRAST_ABSENT.

metformin-pcos-ovulation.basis: randomised metformin-after-laparoscopy vs ovarian diathermy + multivitamins — not a metformin-vs-placebo/clomiphene contrast; the randomised contrast is not the intervention of interest

noac-vs-warfarin-af-stroke.basis: randomised START vs AVOID anticoagulation (start arm = DOAC or VKA; control = antiplatelet/nothing) — not a DOAC-vs-warfarin contrast
